'''Endnotes''' is the final noteworthy section of {{origins}}.

The notes are broken down by chapter, including the [[Origins of the Wheel of Time/Introduction|Introduction]] and the [[Origins of the Wheel of Time/Glossary|Glossary]].

It primarily lists the sources for various assertions made in the book. Most notable among the sources are [[Robert Jordan's notes]], also known as the Rigney Papers. Various other writings by James Oliver Rigney, Jr., fan sites, and social media posts are also used as sources.
